## Part 1

```{r}
#msize = 10000L
msize <- 50L
hmat <- matrix(data = 0L, nrow = msize, ncol = msize)
```

Goal: 29000000

```{r}
for (j in seq_len(ncol(hmat))) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(hmat))) {
    if (i %% j == 0) {
      hmat[i, j] <- 10L * j
    }
  }
}

which(rowSums(hmat) >= 29000000)
```

too big, too slow


```{r}
diffparts(10)
```



Testing SparseMatrix



```{r}
library(Matrix)
msize <- 500L
m <- Matrix(nrow = msize, ncol = msize, data = 0, sparse = TRUE)
m <- as(as(m, "generalMatrix"), "CsparseMatrix")

for (j in seq_len(ncol(m))) {
  if (j %% 5000L == 0) {
    message(paste(j, "Elf"))
    message(paste("sum last house:", sum(m[nrow(m), ])))
  }
  m[seq_len(nrow(m)) %% j == 0, j] <- 10L * j
}
which(rowSums(m) >= 29000000)
```

tested up to 100,000L square matrix
too slow but memory-wise it's great.

```{r}

number_presents <- function(i) {
  elves <- c(DescTools::Divisors(i)[[1]], i)
  sum(elves * 10)
}

house <- 0
present <- 1

# 29000000
while (present < 29000000) {
  house <- house + 1
  present <- number_presents(house)
  if (house %% 20000 == 0) message(paste(house, present))
}
house
```

## Part 2

11 presents. Elves up to 50 houses


```{r}
options(scipen = 999)
library(tictoc)
tic()
elves <- fastmap::fastmap(missing_default = 0)

number_presents2 <- function(i, elves) {
  elf <- c(DescTools::Divisors(i)[[1]], i)
  # check how many house they visit
  for (e in elf) {
    elves$set(as.character(e), elves$get(as.character(e)) + 1)
    if (elves$get(as.character(e)) > 50) {
      #message(paste("rm", e, paste(elf, collapse = ' ')))
      elf <- elf[-which(elf == e)]
      #message(paste(elf, collapse = ' '))
    }
  }
  sum(elf * 11)
}

house <- 0
present <- 1

# 29000000
while (present < 29000000) {
  house <- house + 1
  present <- number_presents2(house, elves)
  if (house %% 20000 == 0) message(paste(house, present))
  #message(paste(house, present))
}
house
toc()
```
